#
 Spiritual
 Translation
 of the Kephalaia Chapter
:
 The Five
 Degrees of Divine Proceeding Against
 Fals
ity

---


**
¶1.
** All
 that
 belongs
 to fals
ity and evil was overcome
 by five degrees
 of the
 Divine proce
eding forth
 from itself
.


**¶2.** The
 first
 degree is
 Divine
 Love itself, which
 exists
 in perfect peace and hid
denness within
 its own infinite being —
 established
 in its own wisdom
,
 in its own essence,
 before
 any
 proce
eding.

**¶3.
** Four further
 degrees of
 Divine proceeding were
 made
 manifest and came forth from Divine
 Love itself
. These
 were
 distributed
 into
 a
 full
ness of remn
ants, and established
 in a
 complete
 whol
eness of all
 the
 truths of faith.

**
¶4.** The second degree fl
owed forth and was made
 manifest.
 It was
 revealed from Divine
 Love itself
. It is the Divine
 truth that
 gives spiritual life —
 the proce
eding Divine spirit
 —
 together
 with the pr
imal understanding of truth
 and
 the particular
 truths born
 from that understanding. These
 constitute
 the second degree.


**¶5.** The
 third degree is the Divine
 wisdom that cher
ishes all truths,
 the ordering
 power
 that
 builds
 the
 structure of the mind
, the active Divine truth that vivifies
 and arran
ges all things,
 together
 with the five derivative
 truths of that
 ordering power.
 These
 constitute
 the third degree.

**¶
6.** The fourth degree is the
 Divine truth sent
 forth
 into
 the ou
termost planes
,
 together
 with the sust
aining principle of Divine order that
 connects
 the interior to
 the exterior,
 and
 all
 particular
 truths that were
 revealed through
 this proceeding. These constitute the fourth
 degree.

**¶7.
** The fifth degree that
 came from Divine
 Love
 is
 the
 Divine wisdom made
 fully
 manifest —
 illumin
ation
 itself
 —
 together
 with all
 its
 particular powers
 of
 perception
 that
 it
 called
 forth,
 all
 the wis
doms that
 flowed out
 and
 were revealed from it
.


**¶8.** This
 un
folding was
 such
 that these
 tru
ths were distributed throughout all
 planes
:
 the particular
 truths of
 the
 pr
imal understanding spread
 throughout
 the entire structure of the spiritual
 mind;
 and
 the particular truths of the ordering
 power were established in five distinct planes,
 sust
aining the whole
.


**¶9.** These
 together
 constitute a
 complete whol
eness of all the truths of faith
. And
 there
 are two
 further
 principles
 joined
 to them: the calling
 forth of Divine infl
ux, and the reception of that
 influx in
 the will — these
 two
 being
 the generating
 good
 and the conce
iving truth
 from
 which all spiritual life is born
.
 The
 Divine
 illumin
ation,
 by its
 coming
, established
 these
 two
 as
 the perpet
ual means of regener
ation in
 its
 
stead
,
 working
 within
 the whole
 external
 mind
 and
 all
 that
 is
 contained ther
ein.

**¶10.
** The descent
 of the
 primal understanding of
 truth
 is
 like
 one
 who exists
 in a state
 of spiritual
 dominion and
 honor
,
 yet
 comes
 down
 among
 those
 hostile
 aff
ections that belong
 to his
 own
 natural
 mind.
 His
 enemies —
 the
 evils and falsities dwelling
 there
 — affl
ict him and
 cause
 him to
 suffer through
 their wick
edness. They
 strip from
 him the outer forms of wisdom
 and
 the
 full
ness of perception
. They imprison that
 understanding
 in captivity and se
ize its
 companion
 tru
ths. Yet
 truth
, through
 its own yiel
ding quality
, end
ures;
 it
 takes
 heart and restrains its
 advers
ary in interior
 silence and
 trust
.

**¶11.**
 Just
 as with
 such
 a person
 —
 a
 noble perception
 whose
 fals
ities sur
round it
 on
 every
 side — so
 it
 was
 with
 the descent
 of the primal understanding of
 Divine
 truth into
 states
 dominated by the
 ruling
 ev
ils,
 the advers
aries
 of all
 wisdom
.

**¶12.**
 In
 contrast
, the coming
 of the active
 Divine truth that
 orders
 and judges
 —
 the truth
 that received
 its
 commission
 from Divine order
 and
 came
 upon
 all
 the ruling
 ev
ils — differs
 from the
 descent of the primal understanding. Its
 advent is not that
 of truth
 suffering among falsities, but of
 truth exercising domin
ion over them.

**¶
13.** The coming
 of the active
 ordering
 truth
 is like this: it
 was
 sent
 from
 the Divine that
 it
 might raise
 up
 the primal understanding from
 subjugation.
 It resemb
les a principle
 of
 just
 discrimination
 that
 the
 Divine
 Love would
 send forth to
 reverse
 the domination of falsity over that
 noble
 perception —
 the
 pr
imal understanding against
 which
 ev
ils had
 off
ended.
 And
 this
 principle
 of
 discrimination
 is
 u
nyielding and
 exact
.
 It provides
 the means of
 restoration
 through
 its
 own righte
ousness and its
 own power
.
 It also
 discrimin
ates among
 all that
 stand
 condemned
,
 each
 according to the
 nature of its opposition
.
 Those
 fals
ities deser
ving painful
 consequences
 it
 strikes
 with the
 hard discipline
 of truth
. Those ev
ils deserving to have
 their derivative
 powers
 sev
ered —
 it
 se
vers them accordingly
.
 It
 binds and restra
ins them, susp
ends
 them, and exp
oses them through
 a
 just
 ordering
.
 It puts
 them to
 spiritual
 death,
 str
ipping away the outermost appearances by
 which they disgu
ised themselves,
 so
 that they per
ish utt
erly as
 active
 states
.
 And
 those
 fals
ities for
 whom it is fitting
 to be
 removed
 from the
 places
 in the mind they had occupied — it
 removes them according
 to just
 order
,
 exactly
 as they had offended against the noble
 understanding
 of
 truth.

**¶14.
** Also
, the subordin
ate truths that serve this
 principle
 of just
 discrimination —
 those
 tru
ths that belong
 to it
 in great
 power
 — in
 an instant they
 execute the will
 of the governing
 truth
 they
 serve
.


**¶15.** Now
, just as this
 genuine
 principle
 of
 discrimination
 was
 sent from the Divine Love
 to
 reverse
 the violence
 done
 to the noble
 understanding
 of
 truth:
 so also
 is it
 with the active
 ordering truth. It too
 was sent from the Divine Love —
 the
 source
 of all wisdom — to reverse
 the injury
 and
 dom
ination infl
icted upon the primal understanding of
 truth
,
 against
 which the
 ruling
 self
-love,
 the sovereign
 of
 all falsity, had offended.
 That
 sovereign
 of
 evil
 and
 all
 its
 rebell
ious powers had
 sin
ned against truth
.
 Therefore
, when the active
 ordering truth came, it raised
 up the primal understanding from subjug
ation.


**¶16.** Also
, all the ruling
 ev
ils —
 the powers of sin that
 had off
ended against the
 particular
 truths born
 from the primal understanding — the
 ordering
 truth jud
ged them each
 according to just
 discrimination
. It
 bound
 them within
 both
 the
 interior and exterior degrees of the mind.
 It
 placed each
 evil
 in the
 state
 fitting
 for
 its nature;
 it we
ighed each according to its cr
uelty and opp
ression. Some
 it enclosed
 entirely
 in restra
int.
 Others it inv
erted,
 so
 that their
 ruling principle was subjugated beneath
 them
.
 Some
 were
 fixed and
 rendered entirely
 powerless. Others were made qui
escent and
 still
. Some were placed
 beneath their
 companion
 ev
ils, held
 fast
 by an
 un
breakable principle
 of order. And
 others were made
 to govern
 over
 the
 ev
ils subordin
ate to them, so
 that each
 restra
ins
 the other according
 to the internal
 order of the hells.


**¶17.** When
 the Divine Good
 established these
 judgments through
 Divine
 Truth, the
 ordering
 truth was
 revealed to all the powers of fals
ity. It jud
ged them
 as
 a
 true
 and faithful
 principle
 of discrimination
.
 This
 is
 the first great
 ordering
 by
 which the active
 Divine
 truth
 arranged
 the
 ruling
 ev
ils in
 relation
 to the primal understanding of truth.
 It gave
 victory to the understanding
 of
 truth in
 proportion
 to
 the truth
's
 own
 end
urance;
 and
 it condemned
 the ruling self-love in
 proportion to that
 by
 which it had dev
iated from order
.

**¶18.**
 This
 restra
ining
 order
 pers
ists throughout
 the whole
 course of regeneration,
 from
 its
 establishment
 until the final
 state
,
 when
 all
 merely
 natural forms
 will
 be dissolved —
 when
 the external
 is
 consumed
 in
 the ultimate
 fire of Divine Love
 and
 all
 things
 are
 finally separated
.
 Then
 wisdom
 asc
ends to its Divine
 origin
, while
 evil and
 falsity remain
 in
 permanent
 restra
int and separation for
 ever.

**¶19.
** The coming
 also
 of the Divine
 truth sent
 into
 the ou
termost planes,
 when
 it came to
 examine
 all that
 had
 been rest
rained and ordered
 within
 the intermediate
 states of
 the mind:
 it
 is
 like
 a sovereign
 wisdom
 that comes and
 insp
ects the tru
ths that have been formed
 and the
 works
 they
 have produced.


**¶20.** And
 those
 truths that are
 good
 —
 the well
-formed per
ceptions and
 the
 well
-ordered under
standings and
 the faithful
 applications
 of truth that
 exist
 in each
 degree
 of
 the mind — when
 this
 sovereign
 wisdom sees
 that
 they have been r
ightly formed
 and have entered
 faith
fully into their
 proper
 works
:
 it rejoices with great delight.
 It acknowled
ges and
 bl
esses the
 truths that have built
 up
 the ordered
 structures
 of the mind and
 fulfilled
 the purposes of
 the Divine.


**¶21.** Now
, just as a
 sovereign
 wisdom comes
 and
 exam
ines its
 works —
 the structures
 and
 prot
ections of
 the mind —
 so also
 is
 the
 advent
 of the Divine
 truth sent
 into the outermost degree
.
 For
 when
 it came, it saw the
 structures
 of the regener
ate mind established
 and prepared
 — all
 the ordered
 states of the ruling
 aff
ections arranged
 and
 fixed
,
 above
 and below, exterior
 and interior, in the
 universal
 pattern
 of heaven
 that
 the prior
 degrees of
 the
 Divine
 proce
eding had made
. Those
 prior degrees had gone
 before it into
 the combat
;
 they had established and
 created
 the ordering of all
 things before
 it came. It
 saw the celest
ial and spiritual truths established
 and
 governing
 the fort
ifications of the mind,
 gu
arding every
 principle
 of
 order —
 all
 that
 the
 prior
 degrees of the Divine proceeding had accomplished
:
 the pr
imal understanding of
 truth,
 the active
 ordering truth, and
 the Divine
 truth that
 gives
 spiritual life.


**¶22.** Therefore
, when it saw
 that
 they had created
 everything with great wisdom, and
 perceived
 the
 full
ness of what
 had
 been accomplished
, it was
 unveiled
 to them
 in
 its
 advent
. It says
 to
 the
 active
 ordering truth: "The discrimination
 you have
 exerc
ised is
 good
.
 What
 you decre
ed, you gave
 to
 each
 according to its
 true
 nature —
 so
 that even
 those
 things
 un
worthy of elevation
 were moved
 and arranged
 into
 states
 beyond
 what
 their own
 nature
 mer
ited." [
*
This
 appears
 to indicate
 that Divine
 mercy
,
 working
 through truth
, elev
ates even
 what
 is unworthy —
 an
 acknowledg
ment that order
 exce
eds strict
 justice.*]

**¶26
.** Then
 the
 calling
-
forth of Divine infl
ux and its
 reception in
 the will — the great
 Divine
 purpose that
 came
 to the
 basic
 constituents of the natural mind,
 which
 lie
 in their
 mixed and
 con
joined state of
 good min
gled with evil —
 it
 per
meated
 them
,
 and it
 was established within
 them sil
ently and
 imper
ceptibly. It sust
ains all things through the entire
 course
 of regeneration, until
 the final state
, when it
 can
 arise
 and stand firm within
 the ultimate
 pur
ifying
 love
.
 Then
 it will
 gather to
 itself every
 particle of genuine
 life
,
 and form
 it
 into the completed
 image
 of the
 Divine —
 the Last
 Form
 of
 the regener
ate person.
 And
 you
 will find that
 it
 separ
ates out
 and
 c
asts away every
 pollution
 of falsity and evil that is foreign
 to the Divine nature
.
 But
 the life and the
 wisdom
 that
 are
 hidden
 in all things —
 these
 it gathers into
 itself and
 builds upon its own
 form
.

**¶27.**
 The time
 when this completed
 image
 of
 the regener
ate person is perf
ected in every
 faculty and capacity — then
 it can become
 free and ascend out
 of the great
 spiritual
 combat
, raised
 up by
 the active
 ordering
 truth, which
 is its spiritual
 father,
 the one
 who comes
 and
 receives
 each
 restored
 faculty
.
 It raises
 the
 whole
 person out of the
 final
 dissolution
 and
 consuming
 of
 all merely natural things.


**¶28.** Now
, this Divine
 purpose
 —
 the calling and the
 reception — resemb
les clar
ified good
 that
 has
 been cooled and
 formed
.
 If
 a person takes
 it
 and places
 it in natural
 truth that
 is still warm
 and
 agitated with
 natural affections, the
 interior
 good mel
ts and per
meates the whole
 of
 that
 natural
 truth. It
 dissol
ves quietly
 and imper
ceptibly into the very
 center
 of the natural
.
 And
 yet
 the living
 essence and
 vital
 quality
 of that natural truth are
 drawn toward
 the interior good;
 the
 natural becomes
 calm
 and is
 brought
 to rest
.
 Then
 the interior
 good clar
ifies and discards what is imp
ure in
 the natural.
 But
 the essential
 good, the vital substance, and the
 delight of
 the natural — these it
 draws
 into
 itself
 and g
athers.


**¶29.** Again
, this too
 is what
 the coming
 of that
 Divine
 intention
 is
 like — the
 purpose
 of
 the living
 Divine
,
 which is the calling
-
forth and
 the reception,
 that
 came
 into
 the basic constituents of the mind
.
 This
 is the principle
 that
,
 at
 the end of
 regener
ation, can
 arise and stand firm,
 and will gather into
 itself all the life and all
 the wisdom that has
 remained
 scattered
 throughout every
 state
.
 It builds
 them
 upon its own form
; it draws
 them into itself
,
 conform
ing them to the Divine image for ever
 and ever,
 from that
 time on
ward.

reconstructions.reconstructed_text: [All that belongs to] the Darkness, it was defeated by five greatnesses.
The first greatness is the Father of Greatness who exists in calm and hiddenness; as he is established in his light-earth, in his own essence.
Four greatnesses were manifested and came forth of him. They were appointed to ten parts, and established in total twelve.

The second greatness poured out and was manifested. It was revealed from the first greatness. It is the Mother of Life, the Great Spirit, together with the First Man and his five sons; these are the second greatness.
The third greatness is the Beloved of the Lights, the Great Builder, the Living Spirit, and the five sons of the Living Spirit. These are the third greatness.
The fourth greatness is the Third Ambassador, and the Pillar of Glory, and all the light powers who were revealed from him. These are the fourth greatness.
The fifth greatness who came from the Father is Jesus the Splendour, and all his powers whom he summoned, his emanations who were [revealed with him.] They poured out and were manifested from him.

This is, so that they were spread out and [established in] fives: these five [sons] of the First Man [are spread out through] the entire building; another five are the five sons of the Living Spirit who are spread out to five places, supporting [heaven and earth.]

[They are a] total in twelve parts that [are all the powers of the light. There are] another two added to them who are the summons and the obedience. They are the father and the mother whom Jesus the Splendour by his advent has appointed as successors to his place [over] the great earth and the [light that is] in them.

[The advent] of the First Man who came [down is like this: he resembles a noble son] belonging to [a great household,] existing in a kingdom [of great] esteem before they who belong to his household[. Yet] his enemies [surround him] and suffering by their wickedness; and they take from him [his garments] and a richness; and they imprison [him in] captivity and take from him their companies (?). Yet, he [endures] by his humility; and he takes heart and restrains his enemy [and abides] in silence.
Just as with this man, this noble son whose enemies surround him, this also is how the advent of the First Man happened, [when he descended among the] rulers, the enemies of the light.

In contrast, the advent of the Living Spirit and the commandment that he received, whereby he came upon all the rulers, it differs from that of the First Man. His advent [is not as] the advent of the First Man.
Also, the associates in the mystery and the assistants of this judge, these who belong to him in great strength; in an instant and haste they shall do the will of their master.

Now, just as this genuine judge, who was sent from the king to overturn the violence to this man, the noble son: this is also the case with the Living Spirit. He also was sent from the King of the lights to overturn the vengeance and violence to the First Man, against whom the King of the realms of Darkness had sinned. He faulted and sinned against him, and also his rebellious powers. Therefore, when (the Living Spirit) came, he bore up the First Man.

Also, all the rulers, the powers of Sin who had faulted and sinned against the sons of the First Man, he has judged them according to a righteous judgement. He has bound them in heaven and earth. He put each one to the place fitting for him; he weighed each of them according to his cruelty and oppression. While some of them he enclosed in the prison, others he hung head down. Some [of them] are crucified, others are sat down all the time. Some among them are fixed beneath their associates, restricted by a strong chain; others he made the holders of authority over their companions beneath, so that they may do their pleasure amongst these below them.

when the Father of Life established the judgements [through the Living Spirit,] He was revealed to all the powers of Darkness. He judged them as a true giver of judgement [and a faithful judge.] This is the first judgement that the Living Spirit gave the rulers [in respect of the] First Man. Indeed, he gave victory to the First Man corresponding to his victory; but he condemned the King of the realms of Darkness corresponding to that by which he had erred.

[And] this chain, of this sort, became [set upon heaven and] the earth till the end time when the universe will be dissolved; and it perishes in the great fire and is separated. While the light goes to its country, the Darkness remains in the chain and fetter for ever.

The advent also of the Third Ambassador, when he came to inspect they who are imprisoned in the zone: he is like a great king who comes and inspects craftsmen [and builders,] and [all their works] and [fortifications.]

Also, they who are good, of the craftsmen and architects and artisans whom he has there in each place: he shall see that they have worked well, and have fallen to his works in their fashion. He shall rejoice with great joy [over them.] He shall thank the artisans who have constructed his works [and completed] his orders.

Now, just as this great king who comes and inspects his works and fortifications, so also is the advent of the Third Ambassador. For, when he too came, he saw [his works] established and prepared and [the whole] series of the rulers prepared and established there, above and below, outside and within, in the great pattern that his brothers had made. They had come before him to the contest, they who had fixed and created the universe before he came. He saw the gods and the angels established and controlling the fortifications [of heaven,] guarding the entire ruling-power [of the universe; all of] which his first powers had done. They are the First Man and the Living Spirit and the Great Spirit, the Mother of Life.

Therefore, when he saw them, that they had created everything with great wisdom, [he rejoiced; and] as they looked he plundered (?) [the powers of Darkness. And] in his advent, by which he came, he was unveiled to them. He says to the Living Spirit: "The judgement that you have [given is] good, what you uttered [is just;] you gave to them correspondingly; so that they were moved and raised up to that of which they were not worthy".

Then the summons and the obedience, the great counsel that came to the elements, which are set in conjunction: it mixed with them, it was established in silence. It bears up [all things] until the end time when it can arise and stand firm in the great fire. It will gather to it its own soul, and sculpt it in the Last Statue. You will also find it sweeps out and casts from it the pollution that is foreign to it. However, the life and the light that are in all things it gathers in to it, and builds upon its body.

The time when this Last Statue will be perfect in all its limbs, then it can become free and ascend from that great struggle through the Living Spirit its father, the one who comes and brings a [living] limb. He brings it up from within this gathering (?), the melting down and destruction of all things.

Now, this counsel, that summons and obedience, resembles thus cooled butter. If a person will take and set it in hot milk, it melts down and soaks in with this hot milk. It melts in another time in silence and quiet to the midst [of the milk;] yet also, of the power and the taste of this milk [, it all] is drawn to (the butter), and (the milk) sets and becomes cold [and still;] in [the end,] and the [dregs of] this milk it shall clarify and discard. However, the oil and the grease and the 'beauty' of the milk it shall gather in to it.

Again, this too is what the advent of that thought is like, the counsel of life, which is the summons and obedience that came to the elements. This is the one that at the end can arise and stand firm, and will gather in to it all the lives, and the light that has remained behind in everything. It can build them upon its body; it will gather them in to it [and sculpt them] in its image for ever and ever [onwards] from this time.

The advent of the Living Spirit is like this, when he was sent from the greatness that he might bring up the First Man. He resembles a judge the king would send to overturn the violence to that man, the noble son against whom his enemies sinned. And he, this judge, [...] hard and cruel [...] and he gives the means [...] by his righteousness and his strength; and he also judges all who are condemned according to their rebellious heart, and repays each according to his deserts. They who are worthy of blows he strikes with hard leather whips. Again, these who are worthy of cutting off their limbs, or indeed their [...] and he repays them accordingly. [...] and he binds and fetters them, and hangs by [...] and thus he does to them with a righteous judgement. And he kills them to flay their skin [...] so that they will be killed by a death [...] until they die. Again, [they for] whom it is fitting [...] to banish from their dwellings he may remove according to a righteous judgement; just as they had faulted and sinned against the noble son.

Again, this is like this simile of the advent of Jesus the Splendour. It happened like this; because he too set out [...] his power and his wisdom, in his [...]-ness [...] in his glorious wisdom he destroyed them. He bound and crushed them like the fire that shall burn and destroy trees. This is also how he performed his will in the zone, among the many powers,
